title: Sensational Gated Residence in Santa Fe, New Mexico
description:
Presented by Sotheby's International Realty - Santa Fe - Main Downtown Brokerage

For more information go to: http://ow.ly/OxDok


Sweeping mountain, sunset and city lights views from almost every room of this sensational gated residence in prestigious Sierra del Norte. The owner spared no expense, working with premier builder Doug McDowell to completely transform & elevate it to an astonishing level of luxury. Spectacular finishes and refined details include scraped bamboo and quartz stone floors, leathered granite counters, antique mesquite doors & wrought iron chandeliers, and exquisite hand-carved cabinetry throughout.
